capabilities: Number display equations by the source order of \label declarations
Resolve \ref and \eqref references to parenthesised numbers in inline and display math
Set the counter to explicit values like 5.1.10 or A.1 with \label{name}[N]
Report labeling errors in place with codes, file name and line number
Configure the reference template, refresh behavior and debug logging
extras: Install is manual or via BRAT; the README documents limitations (single-note references, pane numbering quirks) and includes a full Chinese translation of the documentation.
motivation: The README's Why section says hand-numbering with \tag forces renumbering everything whenever a formula is inserted in the middle, so the author moved the job into the rendering layer.
problem: MathJax in Obsidian has no per-note equation counter and does not make \label/\ref work as in LaTeX, forcing users to hand-type \tag{1}, \tag{2} and renumber after every insertion.

relations.evidence: The plugin calls loadMathJax(), then wraps MathJax.tex2chtml

summary: Math rendering plugin that automatically numbers display equations and resolves LaTeX \label/\ref cross-references without writing tags into the note.
